purpose: Preserve the interview and trace closure of every identified specification decision; owner documents remain authoritative.
interpretation: This is a tracking index, not a source of product, design, architecture or security policy.
Each topic contains several possible follow-up decisions; ask about only one decision at a time.
Write confirmed decisions and their acceptance criteria into the affected owner document, preserving source provenance and updating dependent references.
Do not silently approve assumptions or reopen decisions already settled by the specifications.
Additional gaps listed here are questions to evaluate, not requirements or authorization to add features.
Intentional template placeholders, explanations of uncertainty labels, runtime unresolved-outcome states and hypothetical threat scenarios are not missing product decisions.
Missing historical facts must remain truthful; establish current decisions separately rather than inventing history.
A topic is resolved only when its applicable subdecisions are settled, explicitly excluded or superseded and the owner documents agree.
Recheck the complete repository for gaps and contradictions as answers introduce or remove dependencies; the initial topic list is not a claim of exhaustive build readiness.
Specification review does not establish implementation, security effectiveness, compliance or release readiness.

completed_questions.text: In the first version, what kind of tennis matches should the app support?
completed_questions.selected_option: Singles: one player against one player.

completed_questions.text: How should the eight-player tournament work?
completed_questions.selected_option: Knockout: lose a match and you are out; the last player wins.

completed_questions.text: How should we choose who plays whom in the first round?
completed_questions.selected_option: Use rankings: keep the strongest players apart in the first round.

completed_questions.text: Where should the rankings used to pick the pairs come from?
completed_questions.selected_option: A ranking list from outside the app, such as a club or tennis organization.

completed_questions.text: Which ranking list should we use?
completed_questions.answer: Im not sure, lets just let the orgnaizer decide

completed_questions.text: How should the organizer put those rankings into the app?
completed_questions.selected_option: Type them in: enter a rank for each of the eight players.

completed_questions.text: Which numbers should the organizer enter?
options: The players' actual positions on the outside ranking list, such as 42, 105 or 280.
Just 1 through 8, ordering these eight players from strongest to weakest using the chosen list.
completed_questions.selected_option: Just 1 through 8, ordering these eight players from strongest to weakest using the chosen list.
